description: Raw duty-session GPS points from the adaptive tracker (Start→End Day only, DPDP). Stored append-only; daily km is DERIVED at read time from all points sorted by t (order-independent, preserving C3 §3 convergence) using distance algorithm track_straightline_v0 — PROVISIONAL, not for reimbursement (C7 distance rules; OSRM map-matching + dispute workflow are the M2 financial layer). Wire compaction (delta encoding) is an M2 optimization.
